mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (amphetamine prodrug) increases sympathomimetic activity causing hypertension and tachycardia, while chlorthalidone's diuretic effect may cause electrolyte depletion and hypokalemia, potentiating cardiac arrhythmias and reducing antihypertensive efficacy.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and serum electrolytes (especially potassium) regularly; consider alternative antihypertensive if amphetamine use is necessary, or use lowest effective amphetamine dose with careful cardiovascular surveillance.
